start: HQ, one gym's page, 'Support access' card says 'Closed. Normally the gym opens it ...'; HQ signed in less than 15 minutes ago

steps.action: Pick a 'Reason', write one sentence in 'What happened', pick '30 minutes' in 'For how long', tap 'Open in an emergency'
user_sees: Question 'Open support access in an emergency? It is read-only, it ends by itself, and the gym owner sees it with your reason.'
must_not: Access opened when the question is cancelled

user_sees: Card 'Support access is open': 'Opened by MettleUp (emergency), until <time>. Read-only. The gym owner sees every look.'
must_not: Access opened for more than 60 minutes
The opening missing from the gym owner's list

steps.action: Tap one record button (for example payments)
must_not: Any way to change a record
Records of another gym

user_sees: The card is back to 'Support access' closed
must_not: Records still readable after closing

start: HQ, one gym's page, the gym owner opened access from the admin app

user_sees: 'Opened by the gym, until <time>. Read-only. The gym owner sees every look.'
must_not: The emergency form shown while the gym's own access is open

user_sees: 'Support access is open, so names, devices and addresses show (the gym owner sees this look).' and rows with Who, Device, From
must_not: Names, devices or addresses shown while access is closed

start: HQ, one gym's page, support access closed; HQ signed in more than 15 minutes ago

steps.action: Fill the form and tap 'Open in an emergency', confirm
user_sees: The fresh sign-in words and a 'Sign in again' button
must_not: Access opened without a fresh sign-in

user_sees: Google sign-in, then back on the same gym page
must_not: Landing on the home page and losing the gym
Access opened with no reason the owner can read

start: HQ, a gym page with access open for 15 minutes

steps.action: Wait past the end time and reload
must_not: Record buttons still working after the end time

steps.action: Open it again in an emergency
user_sees: A new open card with the new end time
must_not: The old window counted as still open
The second opening missing from the owner's list

start: HQ, a gym page, access closed, the owner did not ask

steps.action: Open access in an emergency and read members
user_sees: Member names and phone numbers in the table
must_not: A look the gym owner cannot see with its reason
A member list read while the in-app promise says support looks only when the gym lets them

start: Admin app, Help and feedback, card 'MettleUp access' saying 'MettleUp has never opened your records.'

user_sees: Sheet 'Let MettleUp support look?' with 'They cannot change anything.'
must_not: Access opened before 'Yes, for 1 hour'

user_sees: 'Support access is open until <time> (you opened it). Nothing looked at yet.'
must_not: Access open for longer than one hour

user_sees: The look listed on the card
must_not: A look not listed

tests.checks: Opens Help and feedback, taps 'Let MettleUp support look (1 hour)', confirms 'Yes, for 1 hour', sees the open line, taps 'Close it now', sees the closed line; against a mocked server

steps.action: Tap the link 'Help and feedback → MettleUp access'
user_sees: Help and feedback opens with the 'MettleUp access' card
must_not: A blank page or the card missing

tests.checks: Opens Help and feedback, taps 'Let MettleUp support look (1 hour)', confirms 'Yes, for 1 hour', sees the open line, taps 'Close it now', sees the closed line; against a mocked server

start: Admin app signed in as front desk, or a gym not set up online

user_sees: No support button for the desk (the server refuses anyone but the owner), or 'MettleUp access is not switched on for your gym yet.'
must_not: A desk login opening support access

start: Admin app, 'MettleUp access' with access open (you opened it)

user_sees: 'Support access was open <day>, <from>-<to> (you opened it). Nothing was looked at.' and the button 'Let MettleUp support look (1 hour)' again
must_not: HQ still able to read records after closing

tests.checks: Opens Help and feedback, taps 'Let MettleUp support look (1 hour)', confirms 'Yes, for 1 hour', sees the open line, taps 'Close it now', sees the closed line; against a mocked server

start: Admin app, 'MettleUp access', the owner never opened access

steps.action: HQ opens access in an emergency and reads members
user_sees: A line that MettleUp opened access in an emergency, with the reason and what was looked at
must_not: Records read with no line on the card
Any other gym or member seeing this list
